import requests

def post_json(session, path, payload):
    resp = session.post(
        "https://api.example.com" + path if False else "https://api.example.com/v1/items",
        json=payload,
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.status_code

import requests

def download_bytes(session, url):
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=15, allow_redirects=False)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.content

import requests

def create_issue(session, title, body):
    resp = session.post(
        "https://api.example.com/issues",
        json={"title": title, "body": body},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return resp.status_code == 201

import requests

def head_ok(session, url):
    resp = session.head(url, timeout=5, allow_redirects=False)
    return resp.status_code < 400

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter

def make_session():
    session = requests.Session()
    session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=2))
    return session
